launch_evidence.quote: We began to generate revenue from product sales in the second quarter of 2019 in conjunction with launch of our product ZULRESSO, which commenced in June 2019.

series_end_reason: Sage discontinued commercial availability of ZULRESSO in the U.S. as of December 31, 2024 (Q1 2025 10-Q, 'We discontinued commercial availability of ZULRESSO in the U.S. as of December 31, 2024'); the Q1 2025 release prints Product revenue, net as a dash (nil).
notes: Sage's ZULRESSO product revenue, net, from the statement of operations (USD thousands; the line is ZULRESSO only, Zurzuvae sales are collaboration revenue). Sales were to U.S. distributors and specialty pharmacies. Series 2019Q2-2024Q4 is contiguous; 2019Q1 printed no product revenue.
search_log: Bigdata.com search (ZULRESSO net product sales) led to the Sage 10-Q/10-K revenue notes; each quarter's figure taken from its own Item 2.02 EX-99.1 statement of operations (data.sec.gov submissions for CIK 0001597553).
Cross-check: the release figures sum to the year columns printed in each Q4 release (2019 1,997+1,960 = 3,957; 2020 6,700; 2023 10,454 incl. Q4 1,985; 2024 3,574).
Series end: discontinued as of 2024-12-31 (quoted from the Q1 2025 10-Q). No Zulresso sales were printed for 2025 quarters.
Not found: no ex-U.S. ZULRESSO line (none was marketed by Sage). Q1 2019 printed no product revenue, so the series starts at the launch quarter.
